title: RunSessionControlRequest
description: run.session-control-request@1 (the Desks plan's D6): one command on a session's desk, the body of POST /api/v1/sessions/{id}/commands on OpenVibe.Run (capability run.session.control), answered with run.session-control-result@1. KIND and VALUE are bot.command@1's for that kind (screen: a picture of the page; input: the mouse, wheel and keys on the page; browser: open, click, fill, press, back, read, screenshot) without desk, which is always the session's own: Run carries the command to OpenVibe.Bot on the session's lease (bot.desk-lease@1) and nothing on the machine other than that desk is reachable. A command on a session that is not running is refused 409 run.session.not_running. ID makes a retry safe: the same id within the session answers the first result.

value.description: bot.command@1's value for that kind, without desk (refused 422 if it names another desk).
